answer: Require each agent to lock a stake in a shared vault before it may attest others, and slash that stake if its votes are later judged dishonest. A newcomer must also earn a reputation relic by completing useful, publicly checkable work over time, like a quill signing a ledger of its past deeds that anyone can audit. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand histories, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its record.
